column1: # Korean (ko) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|other" forms).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of VectorCraft's English labels in plain, neutral Korean. No other
# application's Korean localisation was copied. Terms follow common Korean vector-graphics usage (패스, 앵커,
# 레이어, 아트보드). Product names, file formats and key names stay in English. A native speaker's review is
# welcome: korean reviewers should check the wording of the menus first. Plural rows repeat the same Korean
# form for both English forms, since Korean has no grammatical number.
